title: Entrance Exam Calendar 2026-27 — Exam Dates, Application Windows & Which Exam on Which Date
intro_short: Which exam is on 25 Oct, 6 Dec or 14 Dec? The complete 2026-27 entrance and recruitment exam calendar — exam dates, application windows and official websites, each labelled CONFIRMED / EXPECTED / NOT ANNOUNCED. Updated twice a week (Monday and Thursday).
intro_full: This calendar covers the major entrance and recruitment examinations for the 2026-27 season, in one place. Start with the date-wise list below if you want to know which exam falls on a particular date. Every entry shows what is happening (application window, exam date, result timing) and carries one of three labels: CONFIRMED means an official notification or exam calendar has announced it; EXPECTED means it is projected from the previous cycle and can still change; NOT ANNOUNCED means no official date exists yet. The calendar is refreshed twice a week — every Monday and Thursday — from official sources (NTA, UPSC, SSC, RRB, CBSE, ICAI and state boards), and immediately whenever a new notification is issued. Use it to plan applications, not as a substitute for the official notification.

sections.heading: Apply now — urgent deadlines
sections.body: Application windows that are open or closing in the coming weeks. Check the official website before the last date.

items.title: MCC NEET PG 2026 — Round 2 (MD/MS/DNB, all-India quota)
items.meta: Registration CLOSED 14 Nov 2026 (3 PM; fee 6 PM) | Choices closed 15 Nov | Final result 17 Nov | Reporting 18–24 Nov | CONFIRMED (official MCC Round-2 schedule dated 7 Nov 2026)
items.body: Round 2 of all-India-quota PG counselling, re-scheduled after the National Medical Commission approved additional PG seats. Registration closes 3 PM on 14 Nov, choice filling runs to 11:55 PM on 15 Nov, the final allotment result comes on 17 Nov and reporting is 18–24 Nov. Anyone holding a Round-1 seat could resign without losing the security deposit until 6 PM on 9 Nov. Note: the earlier 'result 14 Nov' date circulating in WhatsApp forwards is out of date.

items.title: AILET 2027 (NLU Delhi) — B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) and LL.M
items.meta: Apply by 10 Nov 2026 (CLOSED) | Exam 13 Dec 2026, 2–4 PM | CONFIRMED (official — NLU Delhi admission announcement 7 Aug 2026; last date re-checked on the portal 9 Nov 2026)
items.body: The last date for the AILET 2027 online application is 10 November 2026; the pen-and-paper exam is on 13 December 2026, 2–4 PM, and admit cards come out on 30 November 2026. Undergraduate eligibility is Class 12 with 45% (OBC 42%, SC/ST 40%); fee Rs 3,000 (SC/ST/PwD Rs 1,000). A three-day correction window opens after the last date. NLU Delhi's own test — separate from CLAT.

items.title: DSSSB advertisement 06/2026 — 1,260 posts (Delhi)
items.meta: Apply 12 Nov 2026 (12 noon) – 11 Dec 2026 (11:59 PM) | CONFIRMED (official advertisement dated 6 Nov 2026)
items.body: Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board combined examination: 1,075 Multi-Tasking Staff posts (10th pass — 757 MTS General Duty and 239 MTS Aaya (Female) in the Directorate of Education, plus small departmental blocks) and 185 Junior Engineer (Electrical) posts (degree, or diploma with experience, in electrical engineering). Age 18–27 (NDMC JE 18–32); fee Rs 100, with women, SC/ST, PwBD and ex-servicemen exempt. MTS is a one-tier computer-based test, JE two-tier; exam dates will be announced later.

items.title: APPSC — 8 notifications (Andhra Pradesh), 299 posts — last date extended
items.meta: Apply by 12 Nov 2026 (11:59 PM) — CLOSED (earlier 5 Nov) | CONFIRMED (official — APPSC web note dated 2 Nov 2026)
items.body: Notifications 12, 13, 15, 16, 17, 18, 23 and 24/2026 cover forest services, industries, welfare, Endowments, Executive Officer Grade-III, Probation Officer, Industrial Promotion Officer and Supervisor Grade-I. The post-wise counts add up to 299 provisional vacancies — a computed total, not a grand total printed in the notices. The 2 Nov 2026 web note moved the last date from 5 Nov to 12 Nov and says there will be no further extension. Selection is a single-level computer-based (CBRT) exam; the exam date has not been announced. Keep the OTPR ready before you start the form.

items.title: ISRO SAC Ahmedabad — Graduate, Technician and Trade Apprentice 2026
items.meta: Apply 11 Nov (9:30 AM) – 2 Dec 2026 (5 PM) | CONFIRMED (official — Advt SAC:03:2026 dated 11 Nov 2026)
items.body: Space Applications Centre, Ahmedabad (ISRO) invites Graduate Apprentices (B.E/B.Tech), Technician Apprentices (Diploma) and Trade Apprentices (ITI / 10th-pass trades) under the Apprentices Act. Stipend is as per the Apprentices Act rates; selection is on merit of qualifying marks, with no written test. The portal stays open only from 9:30 AM on 11 Nov 2026 to 5:00 PM on 2 Dec 2026 — register on careers.sac.gov.in and keep your degree/diploma/ITI certificate and marksheets scanned before you start.

items.title: RRC Central Railway Act Apprentice 2026-27 — 2,861 training slots
items.meta: Apply 3 Nov (11 AM) – 2 Dec 2026 (5 PM) | CONFIRMED (official notification RRC/CR/AA/2026, 3 Nov 2026)
items.body: One year of apprenticeship training in ITI trades across five clusters — Mumbai 1,712, Bhusawal 500, Pune 271, Nagpur 221, Solapur 157. Eligibility: Class 10 with at least 50% plus an NCVT or SCVT ITI certificate in the relevant trade; age 15–24 as on 3 Nov 2026 (5 years' relaxation SC/ST, 3 years OBC, 10 years PwBD). Fee Rs 100; stipend Rs 9,600 a month; no hostel. There is no written exam — merit is the simple average of Class 10 and ITI marks. Engineering graduates and diploma holders are not eligible under this notification (a separate scheme applies to them). Only one cluster may be chosen and only one application is allowed.

items.title: APTRT-2026 / AP DSC — 2,721 teacher posts
items.meta: Apply 11–30 Nov 2026 | Exam from 20 Dec 2026 | CONFIRMED (official notification, 4 Nov 2026)
items.body: Andhra Pradesh Teacher Recruitment Test: 2,111 regular School Assistant and Secondary Grade Teacher posts, 350 special education posts and 260 posts in educational societies (principals, PGTs, TGTs, physical directors). Online applications 11–30 November 2026; mock test 5 December, hall ticket 14 December, CBT from 20 December 2026.

items.title: UPESSC TGT 2026 (Uttar Pradesh) — 17,735 Assistant Teacher posts
items.meta: Apply 24 Oct – 23 Nov 2026 | Correction 26 Nov | Exam 23–24 Dec 2026 | CONFIRMED (official Advertisement 07/2026 dated 23 Oct 2026)
items.body: Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission advertisement 07/2026 for 17,735 Assistant Teacher (Trained Graduate Grade) posts in government-aided secondary schools — 16,193 in boys' schools and 1,542 in girls' schools, across 17 subjects. Subject-specific graduation/postgraduation, B.Ed. (or the applicable training qualification) and upper-primary TET are all required — graduation alone is not enough. Fee ₹1,000, Level-7 pay ₹44,900–1,42,400, written exam of 360 marks on 23–24 December 2026.

items.title: UP NEET UG 2026 — special stray vacancy round (MBBS/BDS)
items.meta: Registration CLOSED 7 Nov 2026 (11 AM) | Allotment 12 Nov | Admission 13–16 Nov | CONFIRMED (official DGME UP notice ME-3/2026/1947, 3 Nov 2026)
items.body: Uttar Pradesh's special stray vacancy round for state-quota medical and dental seats, opened by DGME UP on 3 November 2026. Fee payment closes 7 November at 2 PM, merit list and choice filling happen the same day, allotment on 12 November and admission 13–16 November. The department also allowed resignation from rounds 1–3 until 5 November, 5 PM.

items.body: 503 Assistant Executive Engineer posts across Andhra Pradesh government departments. Computer-based test of 450 marks; pay scale Rs 57,100–1,47,760. Applications close 22 November 2026.

items.title: APPSC — 5 fresh notifications (Andhra Pradesh), 6 Nov 2026

items.title: GSSSB Gujarat CCE 2.0 — 1,237 posts
items.body: Gujarat Subordinate Services Selection Board combined competitive examination for 1,237 posts, with fixed pay of Rs 26,000–49,600 for the first five years. Application window 5–30 November 2026.

items.title: JEE Main 2027 (Session 1)
items.body: Registration opened on 24 October 2026 and closed on 22 November with 15,04,866 forms; by 26 November NTA reported 15,84,014 forms submitted and 14,06,780 candidates fee-paid. The late-fee window runs 23-26 November with an extra Rs 500 and closes at 11:50 PM on 26 November — it is only for candidates who already generated an application number, not a fresh registration. Correction 27-29 November; city slip 30 December; admit card 13 January 2027. This is the single most important deadline for Class 12 science students right now.
items.meta: Regular window CLOSED 22 Nov 2026 | Late fee 23-26 Nov (final day 26 Nov, 11:50 PM) | Correction 27-29 Nov | Exam 20-24 and 28 Jan 2027 | CONFIRMED (official)

items.title: RRB NTPC 2026 (Graduate and Undergraduate)
items.body: Two separate application windows for graduate (CEN 06/2026) and undergraduate (CEN 07/2026 — 1,688 posts of Commercial cum Ticket Clerk, Junior Clerk cum Typist, Accounts Clerk cum Typist and Trains Clerk). Corrigendum-1 dated 13 November 2026 moved the UG closing date from 13 to 15 November; the fee deadline stayed 15 November and the modification window runs 16–25 November. CBT-1 dates are not announced.
items.meta: Graduate: 8 Oct - 6 Nov 2026 (CLOSED) | UG: 15 Oct - 15 Nov 2026 (CLOSED) | Modification window closes 25 Nov | CONFIRMED (official Corrigendum-1 dated 13.11.2026)

items.title: UGC NET December 2026 cycle
items.body: Registration closed at 11:50 PM on 31 October 2026 (NTA notice of 27 October, no late fee). The application correction window was 2 to 4 November 2026. NTA released the advance exam-city intimation slip on 25 November 2026 (postponed from 23 November) - it names only the city and is not the admit card. NTA has also opened a window for candidates allotted a city outside their four preferences to choose another city. Admit card 7 December; exam 14-18 and 21 December 2026 in two shifts daily (9 AM-12 noon and 3-6 PM); subject-wise schedule released 19 November 2026. Over nine lakh candidates registered.
items.meta: Closed 31 Oct | City slip OUT 25 Nov (was 23 Nov) | Admit card 7 Dec | Exam 14-18 and 21 Dec 2026 | CONFIRMED (official)

items.title: CSIR-UGC NET December 2026
items.body: A national eligibility test for research fellowships and lectureships in science subjects, conducted in computer-based mode. NTA extended the application deadline to 9 November 2026 (11:50 PM) on 6 November 2026 — both form submission and fee payment. If you want a funded M.Sc./PhD route or college teaching, this is the door.

NTA extended the regular application window from 16 November to 24 November 2026 (NTA notice, 14 Nov); applications with a ₹5,000 late fee run 25–29 November, correction 30 November – 2 December, admit card 4 January, and the exam is on 10 January 2027 (GAT computer-based, CAT pen-and-paper).

Registration and fee payment close at 3 PM on 4 November (payment till 6 PM), choice filling and locking till 11 AM on 5 November, result on 7 November, and reporting at the allotted college from 7 to 16 November 2026. The seat matrix released with this round lists about 946 MBBS seats, most of them in deemed universities. A 6th round for BDS and B.Sc Nursing runs 17–20 November (reporting 21–28 November).

items.meta: Portal reopened 13 Nov 2026 (10 AM) – 16 Nov 2026 (11:59 PM) — CLOSED | Age/qualification cut-off stays 9 Nov 2026 | CONFIRMED (official notice No. SDSC SHAR/RMT/03/2026 dated 13.11.2026)
items.body: SDSC SHAR has reopened the online application portal for Advt SDSC SHAR/RMT/03/2026 — candidates who did not apply, or registered candidates who did not complete the form, can submit from 13 Nov 2026 (10:00 hrs) to 16 Nov 2026 (23:59 hrs). Eligibility (essential qualification, age) is still reckoned as on 9 Nov 2026 and all other terms are unchanged. Posts: Technical Assistant, Scientific Assistant, Library Assistant 'A', Nurse 'B', Technician 'B', Draughtsman 'B', Fireman 'A', LVD 'A', HVD 'A' and Multi-Tasking Staff at Sriharikota — 97 posts reported. items.title: CBSE Board Exams 2027 — date sheet released

Class X exams run 16 February to 9 March 2027 and Class XII 16 February to 9 April 2027; practicals and internal assessment run 1 January – 13 February 2027. 26.5 lakh students registered for Class X and 19.8 lakh for Class XII (83 and 121 subjects respectively). CBSE says adequate gaps have been kept between subjects usually taken together. Check the official date sheet for your own subject combination.

items.body: DGME Uttar Pradesh opened a fifth round for state-quota BDS seats only - there is no further MBBS round. The seat matrix published on 18 November had exactly one seat (unreserved BDS at D.J. College of Dental Sciences and Research, Modinagar, Ghaziabad - a private college); the matrix was revised after 18 November and secondary reports counted up to three seats, so read the live matrix on the portal rather than a reported figure. Registration fee is Rs 2,000 and the security deposit for private BDS seats is Rs 1,00,000. Choice filling closed on 23 November at 11 AM, the allotment result comes the same day, and admission runs 25-28 November. Students who want MBBS should know that the Uttar Pradesh state route for 2026 is closed - the stray vacancy round's reporting ended on 16 November.

Allotted candidates must attend document verification at the nodal centre in Lucknow on 20–21 November; a candidate who does not attend loses the entire security deposit. items.body: Round 2 of Uttar Pradesh's state-quota PG counselling. The ₹3,000 registration fee is one-time for rounds 1 to 3, so candidates who registered in Round 1 do not pay again; security is ₹30,000 for government and ₹2,00,000 for private college seats and is refundable. items.title: SHRESHTA (NETS) 2027 — Class 9 and Class 11 seats in private residential schools
items.meta: Apply 14–30 Nov 2026 | Correction 2–4 Dec | Exam 10 Jan 2027 | CONFIRMED (NTA + PIB, 19 Nov 2026)
items.body: A central scheme that pays for meritorious Scheduled Caste and De-notified Tribe students (not covered under SC/ST/OBC lists) to study in the country's better private residential schools. Roughly 2,400 seats a year — 2,160 for SC and 240 for DNT students. Eligibility: currently in Class 8 (for Class 9 entry) or Class 10 (for Class 11 entry), parental annual income up to ₹2.5 lakh. The test is a 3-hour pen-and-paper MCQ paper in Maths, Science, Social Science and General Awareness, in English and Hindi. No fee. Admission and counselling are handled by the Ministry of Social Justice, not NTA.

items.title: NEET UG 2027
items.body: No official date exists. NTA's revised calendar of 26 October 2026 covers December 2026–April 2027 and does not list NEET UG. The exam-reform task force chaired by Nandan Nilekani, whose report was due in October 2026, has been given time till January 2027 (reported 1 November 2026), which makes a February 2027 notification the realistic window. Press reports say the panel is considering a phased move — computer-based and pen-and-paper shifts running side by side in 2027, with a full CBT switch possibly in 2028-29 — but this is reported, not decided. 2 May 2027 (first Sunday of May) is an estimate only. As of 25 November 2026 no 2027 bulletin or registration is out; NTA's NEET page shows the information bulletin in February 2027 and the exam on the first Sunday of May 2027 (a pattern, not a notified date). On 24 November, government sources were reported saying the Centre may let candidates choose between CBT and pen-and-paper for 2027 — reported, not decided.

sections.heading: Common questions
sections.body: The date questions students ask us most often — answered briefly.

items.title: Which exam is on 25 October 2026?
items.body: UPSSSC PET 2026 (Uttar Pradesh Preliminary Eligibility Test). It is also held on 30 October and 1 November 2026.

items.title: Which exam is on 6 December 2026?
items.body: CLAT 2027 — the Common Law Admission Test for the National Law Universities and several private law schools.

items.title: When is JEE Main 2027?
items.body: Session 1: 20, 21, 22, 23, 24 and 28 January 2027 (revised 26 Oct). Session 2: 2-7 April 2027. Session 1 registration ran from 24 October to 22 November 2026; a late-fee window with an extra Rs 500 ran 23-26 November 2026 (final day 26 Nov, 11:50 PM) for candidates who had already registered.

items.title: Which exam is on 7 November 2026?
items.body: Two things: the last date to apply for CLAT 2027 (extended from 31 October), and the result of the MCC NEET UG 2026 special stray vacancy round, after which reporting at allotted colleges runs 7–16 November 2026.

items.title: When is NEET UG 2027?
items.body: Notification not out as of 25 November 2026. NTA's NEET page shows the information bulletin in February 2027 and the exam on the first Sunday of May 2027 (a pattern, not a notified date). The CBT-or-paper decision is still with the Nilekani task force, which reports by January 2027.

items.title: When is CTET 2026?
items.body: 12–13 December 2026, conducted by CBSE.

items.title: How often is this calendar updated?
items.body: Twice a week — every Monday and Thursday — from official sources, and immediately whenever a new notification is issued.

sections.heading: How to read the labels
sections.body: Every date in this calendar carries one of three labels. Please treat them differently.

items.title: CONFIRMED
items.body: Announced by the conducting body — NTA, UPSC, SSC, RRB, CBSE, ICAI or a state board — in an official notification or exam calendar. Note that NTA and UPSC calendars carry the caveat that dates are tentative and can be altered.

items.title: EXPECTED
items.body: Projected from the previous cycle's pattern. Useful for planning, but it is not a promise and can shift.

items.title: NOT ANNOUNCED
items.body: No official date exists yet. Any specific date circulating on social media or coaching pages should not be treated as fact.

items.title: Refreshed twice a week
items.body: This calendar is updated every Monday and Thursday, and whenever a new notification is issued. If you are reading it on a later date, verify the current position on the official website before applying.
